items.sentence: This calculator uses the Boer formula, published by P. Boer in 1984, to estimate lean body mass from height and weight.

items.sentence: Boer used it to normalise body fluid volumes: blood volume, measured in 66 healthy adults, and extracellular fluid volume, measured in 54, lined up with estimated lean body mass the same way in men and women, and none of the other indices he tried (weight, height, body surface area, a leanness index) did (Boer, 1984).
